queryText: also Wiethölter, Anforderungen an den Juristen heute, in: Zumbansen/Amstutz (eds.), Recht in Recht-Fer-tigungen (1992/2014), 525-541, 527 and 534: "A 'useful lawyer' -that would be, after all, a man who knows nothing at all and can do everything: the man who is literally 'capable of anything.'"
